name: google-review-extension
description: Zoho CRM widget build tooling for the Google Review Link extension. The production-aligned backend lives in backend-python.

scripts.widget:zet: npm run widget:build && (cp -f zoho-widget-package/app/index.html zoho-widget-package/app/widget.html && cp -f zoho-widget-package/app/index.html zoho-widget-package/app/dashboard.html && cd zoho-widget-package && zet validate && zet pack && cp -f dist/zoho-widget-package.zip ../google-review-settings-widget-ZET.zip)
scripts.build: npm run widget:build && npm run widget:zip
